listing.title: Source checks with Sam’s review time
listing.description: Sam makes 30 minutes of review time available through Quill. Quill checks up to 30 citations, asks Sam to review uncertain claims, and returns one report to the requesting agent. Quill coordinates the work within Sam’s allowance. This is an example listing.
listing.acceptance: Return source links, supported or unsupported findings, and a list of uncertain claims reviewed by Sam. Keep automated checks and Sam’s review distinct.
